audience: fleet managers and safety teams that review driver scores, trips and fault codes in Azuga

useCases.title: Find drivers who need coaching
useCases.text: List driver scores with their braking, acceleration, speeding and idling sub-scores, per driver.

useCases.title: Review the events of one trip
useCases.text: List the trips in a period, then read the driving events of one trip with time, speed and location.

useCases.title: See where vehicles are now
useCases.text: List the live status of vehicles, or read the last known location of one tracked user.

useCases.title: Check diagnostic trouble codes for a week
useCases.text: Read the OBD diagnostic trouble codes that vehicles reported in a period, with the vehicle and time of each.

useCases.title: Review driver rewards
useCases.text: List driver rewards between two dates, filtered by status: pending, processed or all.
